Sysvar account update and instruction account check declarations with rent constants.

# Purpose
This header file declares common interfaces for Solana-style sysvar handling in the Flamenco runtime. It defines two sysvar constants, `FD_SYSVAR_RENT_UNADJUSTED_INITIAL_BALANCE` and `FD_SYSVAR_INITIAL_RENT_EPOCH`, and it declares [`fd_sysvar_account_update`](<#fd_sysvar_account_update>), which writes sysvar data to the account database without updating the sysvar cache. It also declares [`fd_sysvar_instr_acct_check`](<#fd_sysvar_instr_acct_check>), which checks whether an instruction account matches an expected public key. The file includes runtime bank and base type definitions and notes that more shared sysvar read and write helpers should be moved into this header later.

- `fd_sysvar_instr_acct_check`
